name: Welcome Email
subject: Welcome to STEMulus, {{student_name}}! 🚀
body:
Welcome to the STEMulus Family!

Dear {{parent_name}},

We're thrilled to have {{student_name}} join our {{course_name}} program! Get ready for an exciting journey of learning, creativity, and innovation.

What's Next?

  • You'll receive a class schedule and Zoom link before your first session
  • Make sure your child has a computer or tablet ready
  • Questions? Reply to this email anytime!

Let's ignite the spark of coding! 🌟

Warm regards,
The STEMulus Team

subject: 🎉 Congratulations {{student_name}}! You've completed {{course_name}}!
body:
🎓 Certificate of Achievement!

Dear {{parent_name}},

We are delighted to announce that {{student_name}} has successfully completed the {{course_name}} program at STEMulus!

Completion Date: {{completion_date}}

This is a significant accomplishment, and we're incredibly proud of {{student_name}}'s dedication and hard work. Your child has developed valuable skills that will serve them well in the future.

What's Next?

Explore our other exciting programs to continue the learning journey! Check out:
